recentItems.title: Jewish Art & Identity at Miami Art Week with Ariel Penzer Milgroom and Alejandro Glatt | Tzuzamen
recentItems.description:
At Miami Art Week, Tzuzamen features philanthropist Ariel Penzer Milgroom and artist Alejandro Glatt discussing Art World for Israel, their initiative fostering Jewish artistic expression and community. They explore art as a medium for identity, pride, and peace while addressing challenges Jewish artists face. Alejandro also shares Feel the Fruit: Papaya, making history as the first Mexican Jewish artist to send a papaya to the moon—a milestone in cultural preservation.

Art World for Israel: https://www.artworldforisrael.com/about-us

recentItems.title: Theater, Resilience, and Hope Amid Crisis with Alon Ophir | Tzuzamen
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Exploring Dialogue Through Art with Igal Ezraty | Tzuzamen
recentItems.description:
Igal Ezraty, Artistic Director of the Arab Hebrew Theater in Jaffa, discusses its mission to foster dialogue and cultural understanding. The theater unites Jewish and Arab artists and audiences, creating performances that bridge divides. Ezraty emphasizes its focus on language, collaboration, and storytelling, showcasing shared Arabic and Hebrew heritage while promoting empathy and coexistence.

recentItems.title: A Monodrama 'Shamira Imber' with Yoav Ginai, Alon Ofir, and Actress Meirav Gruber [Hebrew]
recentItems.description:
Writer Yoav Ginai, Director Alon Ofir, and Actress Meirav Gruber  join Tzuzamen to discuss the emotional and humorous monodrama Shamira Imber starring Meirav Gruber. Set on the final day of Shamira's life, the play follows her courageous decision, driven by inner perfection, to undergo medical treatment that will end her life. The trio shares insights into the creative process behind the production, highlighting the unique experience of blending humor with emotion and incorporating live music, as well as the play's inspirational message of bold female empowerment. The play won first prize at the one man show Theater Festival.

Tzuzamen is hosted by Tzili Charney and Tzipi Trope.
Learn More about Monodrama Shamira Imber

recentItems.title: The Women's Courtyard: Empowering Girls in Israel with Orna Barbivai & Hadas Lebovitch [Hebrew]
recentItems.description:
Orna Barbivai, former IDF major general and Economy and Industry Minister, joins Tzuzamen with writer Hadas Leibovich to discuss The Women's Courtyard. This organization offers a safe, inclusive space for young women to heal, grow, and overcome personal and systemic challenges, regardless of their backgrounds. Through meaningful connections, practical support, and advocacy, it challenges systemic exclusion and drives policy changes to create lasting impact.

The Women's Courtyard gives young at-risk girls a safe place to grow, develop, and find their place in the world. https://hatzer.org.il/en

recentItems.title: From Loss to Compassion, Buma Inbar's Mission [Hebrew] | Tzuzamen
recentItems.description:
Buma Inbar, an Israeli humanitarian and bereaved father, joins Tzuzamen to share his journey of turning personal loss into a mission for peace. After losing his son in the Lebanon War, Buma has dedicated his life to bridging divides, providing vital support to Palestinians seeking medical care in Israel, and working with Ethiopian immigrants and ultra-Orthodox communities. 

As co-founder of the Joint Palestinian-Israeli Bereaved Families Forum and the Alternative Memorial Day ceremony, Buma highlights the power of compassion and dialogue in fostering understanding between Israeli and Palestinian societies.

Tzuzamen is hosted by Tzili Charney and Tzipi Trope.
Guest: Buma Inbal

recentItems.title: Honoring Jimmy Carter and Analyzing Israel’s Challenges with Ido Aharoni | Tzuzamen
recentItems.description:
Former Israeli Consul General Ido Aharoni joins Tzuzamen to honor Jimmy Carter following his passing this week. Reflecting on Carter’s legacy of compassion and the Camp David Accords, Aharoni examines the profound challenges Israel faces post-October 7th, including rising anti-Semitism, economic strain, and societal shifts. He also highlights his upcoming lecture series at the Striker Center, which explores the multifaceted impacts of recent events on Israel.
